description:
[Servers] One server in full. Everything the server's page shows except the live player names: the full public record (see `/servers`)
read fresh, plus `votes`, `rating` (1-5 average) and `rating_count`, the last ten detected `wipes` (newest
first, with the seed/size before and after), `last_wipe_at`, `avg_wipe_cycle_hours` across those wipes,
`next_wipe_estimate_at` (last wipe + average cycle; a guess, not a schedule), `next_force_wipe_at` (Rust's
monthly forced wipe) and `map_preview` - the server's map drawn from the server's own map file (or generated
from its seed + size), null until one is drawn: `image_url` (labelled, 1440 px), `thumbnail_url` (480 px),
`images`, `total_monuments`, `monuments` (`{type, x, y}`), `monument_types`, `land_percentage`, the five
`biome_*` percentages, `source_note`, `generated_at` and `is_previous_wipe` (true while a wiped server's new
map is still being drawn - see `/servers/{id}/map`). Offline servers still resolve; unknown ids are 404.
Player-count history is at `/servers/{id}/history`. Aggregates are cached for five minutes.

server_id.description: The server's numeric id (from `/servers`, or the number in its servers.rustprofit.com/server/{id} URL).

name: get_server
title: One server in full
